source_findings: Frozen workbook Quality Checks A36:D36 and Internal Quality Checks A36:D36 require grading defining behavior plus durable server state; public network does not imply same-origin.

instruction.md:1-4 asks for running JS/HTML, actual last-good preview after failure/Stop, saved revisions and two-editor safety; environment/instructions/behaviour.md and integration.md require current/history/restore-attempt durability over reload and process restart.
tests/gates/render/judge.toml:17-36 tests a fresh computed authored Run in preview and console, so a dead editor cannot clear Render.

tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:17-33 and prompt.md:14-30 require actual UI save/write response plus independent clean-context server read and fresh-context reload; health/static/client storage alone cannot clear Constraints. A server-rendered document is accepted, and no same-origin restriction is imposed.
tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:165-168 and prompt.md:273-286 test failed-run rollback of a genuinely changed preview input and painted canvas; mere rerun of source would lose those mutations.

tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:325-343, 549-553, 583-595 and prompt.md:426-434 test browser reload, completed process restart, current records, history snapshots, restore retry and post-restart write/readback.

verified_local_evidence.scope: focused scripted reference canvas/form recovery regression
post-phase source assertions compare fresh server library, each history, original retry and later write against recorded pre-phase state; this is scripted test logic, not configured judge execution

weak_app_probe: A server that saves only in process memory could satisfy the clean-context gate and reload but should fail S22 after a real process restart; a browser-local-only saved library should fail the clean-context server read in Constraints. A dead Run should fail Render despite static preview text.
conforming_alternative_probe: A compliant implementation may use any UI layout, API route and response representation, including a server-rendered document or public-network assets. The gate discovers actual requests and accepts independent clean-context server retrieval without requiring same-origin or a particular database response schema.
measurement_limit: No exact-current configured functional judge/Oracle/target-model result is indexed. Local scripted golden passes do not exercise the detached-listener bypass. The post-results artifact reports exact pre/post data comparisons and history_proof.cjs:11-16 shows those assertions, but the index does not contain a raw container-restart command/log.

false_success_path.mechanism: Old detached child listener remains on port 3000 after wrapper group kill; helper sees its HTTP response and returns success despite replacement bind failure. A memory-only library can then pass S22 readbacks.
false_success_path.status: source-demonstrated path; no adversarial runtime was run
